phases.title: P0 Baseline
phases.goal: One measured inventory, the board, tokens with the right scopes, and the list of rulings.
phases.exit: estate.sh walk published; board live; rulings issue open; sandbox Zenodo token stored by path.

phases.title: P1 Close the releases
phases.goal: Everything built is released, and every defect found by execution is fixed.
phases.exit: All P1 gates green; Rahnuma 1.3.0 frozen on the rulings.

phases.title: P2 Licences and DOIs
phases.goal: Every repository carries a licence file and correct metadata; minting covers the estate by family.
phases.exit: The walk shows no repository without a licence and no record missing AyeAI, ORCID or version.

phases.title: P3 Collaboration infrastructure
phases.goal: A newcomer can go from Rahnuma to a merged pull request in one sitting.
phases.exit: Kit synced to all active repositories; ten good first issues open; darwaza seeded; enablement brief published.

phases.title: P4 Reference lab and courses
phases.goal: The reference lab runs from launch scripts, with GATE-aligned modules and a pilot.
phases.exit: Lab scripts released; CS and robotics modules reviewed; one pilot institution running.

phases.title: P5 Papers and IPR
phases.goal: Disclosure ledger first, then preprints of the four papers with results.
phases.exit: Ledger published internally; four preprints cleared and posted; patent decision memo signed off.

phases.title: P6 Monetisation
phases.goal: Two offers defined and priced, on the dossier standard.
phases.exit: Dossier Phase 0 confirmed; two offers with MRD and commercial dossier.

phases.title: Lanes: every collaborator and every domain
phases.goal: Every collaborator type and every domain family has a visible lane on the board, with an entry point, open work and a way to propose more.
phases.exit: every lane has a steward or a pinned open call; every domain family has at least one seeded task
